name: Subtitles
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Load external subtitles, pick tracks, adjust style and sync
description:
Pick and switch subtitle tracks, load SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, SAMI and MicroDVD subtitles (the encoding is detected), also the ones named like a local video when it opens, show a secondary subtitle; adjust size, position, font, colour, outline, shadow and background box, and the sync; jump by dialogue; reload external subtitle files automatically when they change.
Find it in the right-click menu under Subtitles.
